top_signals.title: Cosmos Labs says it wrongly cleared the bug behind a $5.7 million six-chain hack
top_signals.summary: MANTRA Chain, which lost $3.6 million, claimed the patch was only released 20 hours before the attack began and did not identify the flaw it fixed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
